{{Top|leg}}
A '''light hour''' was a unit of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] measurement. [[Star/Legends|Stars]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] could be located light hours apart due to the density of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].
